article.title: “Little Hands, Big Change”: 8-Year-Old Kenyan Climate Champion Marren Akeyo Speaks Out at COP31
article.content: At the U.N. climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, Little Miss Environment Kenya 2026, Marren Akeyo, addressed world leaders on their responsibility to take real action to stop climate change. “Climate change does not ask for your birth certificate before affecting you. So, why should we wait until we’re adults to protect our planet?” said 8-year-old Akeyo. “We are ready to grow food. We are ready to take care of our planet. But we need you to give us opportunities. Don’t just tell us, ’You’re the leaders of tomorrow.’ Let us lead something today. Start with what you have.”
